name: intervals-icu-mcp
description: Access your Intervals.icu training data — activities, calendar, fitness metrics, power curves, workout planning, and a managed library of saved workouts that can act as a coaching template store.

intervals_athlete_id.title: Athlete ID
intervals_athlete_id.description: Your Intervals.icu athlete ID, or leave blank to use the authenticated user

prompts.name: setup_coaching
prompts.description: Walk the athlete through a short interview, then emit their personal season.md and steering.md for docs/personal/ (philosophy is the tracked coaching-philosophy skill).
prompts.text: Run this prompt to bootstrap your personal coaching files. The LLM reads the coaching-philosophy skill (your durable principles, tracked in git), calls get_coaching_context for FTP/zones/fitness, then interviews you on your current season and any personal steering. The output is season.md and steering.md for docs/personal/ — layered on top of the philosophy skill, steering overrides on conflict.
